create_image_dataset: create an ImagePathDataset from image files with configurable batch size and transforms
predict_sample: run the model to predict a label for a single image sample
extract_features: extract feature embeddings from an image sample using the model
from_model: instantiate a ClassyHubInterface from an existing PyTorch or ClassyModel
get_data_iterator: get an iterator over a ClassyDataset to retrieve training or testing samples
